meta.title: Pope County — the money trail
meta.note: This is the county's 2026 budget (Ordinance 2025-O-053) as filed with the state. Fund and department amounts are the "2026 Appropriated" column of the ordinance's appropriation table; the categories come from each office's budget request, which adds to the same amount. Some dollars are counted twice: transfer lines move $801,471.78 between the county's own funds (for example $567,471.78 from the General Fund to 911), so that money also appears in the fund that receives it.

nodes.name: Other services and charges
nodes.note: No subtotal is printed; this is the one line item in this category.

nodes.name: Circuit Court Automation-Dunham
nodes.note: The form prints category subtotals of $12,250.00 (supplies) and $18,000.00 (other services), which add to $30,250.00, but its printed total and the appropriation are $30,000.00.
